description: Several pointed temple spires of unequal size spread across an open landscape. Two rounded balloon envelopes with small detached baskets float above the left side, while the tallest temple stands to the right.

A tall tiered stupa with a pointed finial stands above three smaller matching stupas. Each structure has stepped shoulders and a broad base, forming a centred group with the smaller monuments across the foreground.
A robed statue stands on a flared pedestal with both arms extended horizontally. The circular head sits above broad hanging sleeves, and a diagonal fold crosses the long straight body.
A torii gate has two outward-splayed posts supporting a broad upturned top lintel. A lower crossbeam extends past both posts, with a short central upright connecting it to the upper lintel.
A slender torii gate has two slightly splayed posts beneath a broad curved lintel with raised ends. A straight lower crossbeam crosses both posts, leaving the opening beneath the upper beam unmarked.

A left-facing Merlion head has an open projecting muzzle and a curved interior cheek line. A pointed mane edge crosses the lower head above a rounded lower body, with a straight outer edge on the right.
A tiered fountain has a small upper bowl above a larger lower basin on a flared foot. A central jet rises above the top bowl and divides into two downward-curving streams.
A shrine gateway has a broad curved lintel with raised ends above two pairs of straight posts. The inner and outer supports frame a wide central opening and meet a shared horizontal baseline.
A tall totem pole has a rounded top, two short eye marks, and a long straight body. Symmetrical outstretched wings project from its sides, each with a stepped curved lower edge.
A bell-shaped stupa rises from a broad rectangular plinth with a wider baseline. Its smoothly swelling body narrows toward a tall pointed conical finial above the rounded shoulders.
